name: Unnamed BSC DEX Router
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: An unnamed DEX router on BNB Chain was exploited because uniswapV3SwapCallback did not authenticate a real V3 pool. The attacker used a fake pool, set victims as payer, and drained existing token allowances via transferFrom, stealing about 62.28 WBNB from 29 wallets in one transaction.
